en.headline: Hong Kong men win Asian Games sevens gold, women take bronze
en.dek: RTHK said the men beat the national team 26-0 in Nagoya to complete a third straight title, taking the gold count to 11.
body: Hong Kong's men's sevens side beat the national team 26-0 in the Asian Games final in Nagoya on Saturday, defending the title and completing a third consecutive gold, RTHK reported. The result took Hong Kong's gold tally at these Games to 11, a new high, and the overall medal count to 54, above the previous edition.

RTHK said a Hong Kong player scored twice in the first half as the side led 21-0 at the break, before another try in the second half made it 26-0. The national team pressed late but did not score. The two sides had already met in the pool stage, which Hong Kong also won.

In the women's bronze match, Hong Kong beat Thailand 7-5, leading at half-time and neither side scoring after the break, RTHK said. It was a second straight bronze for the women's team. The culture, sports and tourism secretary, Rosanna Law, later posted that the Games tally had reached 11 golds.

zh.headline: 男子七欖亞運三連冠 女子隊再奪銅牌
zh.dek: 港台報道，港隊在名古屋決賽以26比0擊敗國家隊，完成三連冠，今屆金牌增至11面。
body: 港台報道，港隊男子七人欖球周六在名古屋亞運決賽以26比0擊敗國家隊，成功衛冕並實現三連冠。港隊今屆金牌增至11面，創歷史新高，獎牌總數增至54面，超越上屆。
港台指，港隊上半場有球員兩次達陣，半場以21比0領先，下半場再添一球達陣，比數擴至26比0。國家隊尾段嘗試反攻，但未能得分。兩隊分組賽曾經交手，當時亦由港隊勝出。
女子銅牌戰，港隊以7比5擊敗泰國，上半場領先，下半場雙方都沒有得分，港台報道。這是女子隊連續兩屆取得銅牌。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩其後在社交平台表示，名古屋亞運已取得11金。
